title: A self-billed invoice reaches QuickBooks under its own customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company that you can sign in to.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, linked to a QuickBooks customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. In QuickBooks, open the invoice with work order 1's invoice number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 4:

  • The QuickBooks invoice is on customer A's linked QuickBooks customer, as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12319 (Story 17, QuickBooks sync)

  • S17-R1: “The invoice is sent to QuickBooks with the Bill To as its customer.”
  • Goals: “A shop that never picks a different Bill To sees every total, balance, report and document unchanged.”
